authority_invariant: These governed extensions preserve source-backed identities and bounded maturity without changing the frozen Penta OS V1.5 canonical registry, manufacturing execution eligibility, granting provider authority, moving money, granting rights, exposing credentials, creating vote/quorum effect, self-certifying, or performing D3.

systems.purpose: Provider-neutral delivery executor for approved outbound, transactional, nurture, notification, and exception-channel messages, including deterministic idempotency, send windows, caps, suppression, retry, provider acceptance, and delivery-state reconciliation.
systems.authority_boundary: PentaMailer transports only work already authorized by the owning communications or campaign contract. It cannot invent recipients, offers, consent, claims, provider credentials, spend, rights, legal commitments, or D3 authority.

systems.purpose: Immutable persona identity, versioned role contracts, selection, disclosure, knowledge-source binding, privacy, channel behavior, handoff, escalation, model-replacement, and authority-bound execution projection.
systems.authority_boundary: A persona is a governed presentation and routing identity. It never receives independent credential, financial, rights, legal, provider-write, voting, certification, deployment, or D3 authority.

systems.purpose: Resolve an admitted persona contract, bounded task context, authority trace, channel contract, knowledge sources, deterministic controls, and evidence requirements into an executable persona session with explicit handoffs and terminal receipts.
systems.authority_boundary: Runtime selection or model output cannot expand the persona contract, override suppression or privacy, impersonate another identity, self-certify, grant provider access, move money, grant rights, or perform D3.

systems.purpose: Discover, reconcile, design, build, schema-validate, adversarially test, identify, secure, preserve, document, version, package, monitor, and continue persona contracts without self-approving their production admission.
systems.authority_boundary: The factory may produce candidates and evidence only. It cannot approve its own output, manufacture persona authority, create credentials, activate provider writes, publish customer-facing identities, move money, grant rights, or perform D3.

systems.purpose: Build and maintain provider-neutral communications contracts, adapters, templates, deterministic transport controls, suppression logic, evidence schemas, recovery packages, tests, skills, and documentation for the PentaMail family.
systems.authority_boundary: The factory creates source candidates and evidence; it cannot send messages, activate credentials, grant provider-write authority, waive compliance, self-certify, or perform D3.

systems.purpose: AdLuxe Network-governed advertiser, publisher, campaign, line-item, creative, inventory, zone, placement, targeting, pricing, pacing, measurement, attribution, transaction-evidence, payout-evidence, disclosure, reconciliation, and recovery coordination.
systems.authority_boundary: PentaAds may coordinate only admitted campaigns, inventory, creatives, pricing, and provider routes. It cannot invent consent, rights, placement ownership, advertiser funds, publisher earnings, payout authorization, credentials, certification, or D3 authority.

systems.purpose: Build and maintain PentaAds contracts, adapters, zone and placement schemas, creative and campaign packages, test fixtures, disclosure controls, recovery artifacts, skills, documentation, and certification requests.
systems.authority_boundary: The factory produces source candidates and evidence. It cannot create live campaigns, spend budgets, charge advertisers, pay publishers, activate placements, issue rights, expose credentials, self-certify, or perform D3.

systems.purpose: Source-neutral placement loader, signed or governed installation manifests, zone and slot identity, adapter routing, idempotent rendering, provider readback, measurement handoff, supersession, rollback, and recovery for PentaAds inventory surfaces.
systems.authority_boundary: Source availability or a loader render does not create campaign, pricing, consent, rights, provider-write, billing, payout, certification, or D3 authority.
